findings.title: HTTP error logging exposes proxy credentials
findings.body: A supported URL such as https://proxy.example/arr?token=proxy-secret passes InstanceConfig validation and reaches validate_connection through startup.py:154–160. On a 502 response, the newly logged HTTPStatusError includes the request URL and proxy-secret (verified with installed HTTPX). collect_secrets only collects API keys and auth secrets, so neither logging sink redacts this URL token. Previously this branch logged only the status code; now the credential reaches stderr and the web log buffer.
findings.recommendation: Keep logging the status code instead of the raw exception, or explicitly strip credentials and query values before logging. Add a regression test using a configured URL token and a 502 response against both logging sinks.

next_steps: Restore bounded HTTP error logging and verify that URL credentials never appear in logs.
